caption:
Every car has one driver.
And one person running mission control.

Maps said left in 300 meters.
She said LEFT-LEFT-LEFT now.

The AC had a committee.
The playlist had a veto.
And somehow, he still asked, "Captain, next?"

Maybe love is one steering wheel and two opinions.

Send this to your favorite passenger-seat supervisor.
alt_text: Illustrated carousel about a couple driving together, where the passenger becomes playful mission control.
Aachu supervises directions from the passenger seat while Zuv drives safely and fondly plays along.
The story uses car/cab behavior as a funny, affectionate proof of shared couple rhythm.
